verdicts.reason: A: the tiny leaderboard keeps a fairly legible two-line headline and an orange CTA pill on the right. But the bottle, the Sunset Sale ribbon and the visible logo are gone, and the LIMITED EDITION badge is jammed against or onto the headline with uneven spacing. B is worse: it squeezes a four-line headline, unreadable micro body copy, three badges, the CTA and the legal line into 50px. The CTA becomes a tiny pill lost among the badges, the text is illegible and the product is missing, so it has no clear hierarchy.
